items.title: Applications open for October 2026/2027 intake
items.summary: UCC invites qualified candidates to apply for DCIT, DBIT, CCIT and CBIT programmes. Applications open 1 June and close 30 September 2026.

items.title: Reporting for October 2026/2027 intake
items.summary: Successful applicants are expected to report for studies in November 2026 for the Academic Year 2026/2027.

items.title: Application fee: TZS 15,000 local / TZS 30,000 foreign
items.summary: Non-refundable application fee. Local applicants pay via M-Pesa, Mix by Yas or Airtel Money. Foreign applicants pay by SWIFT to CRDB Bank, code CORUTZTZ.

items.title: UCC is an Authorised Pearson VUE Testing Centre
items.summary: UCC offers Microsoft and Cisco certification exams. Contact info@ucc.co.tz or +255 22 2410641/5 for current exam schedules.
